d: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen delivers a forceful message to Russian President Vladimir Putin, declaring that he cannot break Ukraine's resistance or its spirit. Addressing the European Parliament, she accuses Russia of intensifying attacks on Ukrainian cities and critical infrastructure, while vowing that Europe will continue supporting Kyiv. Von der Leyen announces a proposed €45 billion support package for Ukraine in 2027 and outlines the EU's 22nd sanctions package targeting Russian banks, cryptocurrency networks, energy services and its shadow fleet.
